llm.summary: This is a simple competitor-analysis skill that asks the agent to research public websites and reviews, with no executable code or hidden privileged behavior found.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is competitive product analysis, and the requested capabilities are public web fetching, search, pricing/review extraction, and structured reporting, which fit that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to user-provided competitors and comparative research; no prompt override, hidden role change, credential handling, or unrelated system manipulation was found.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains only one markdown skill file and no executable scripts, package dependencies, install hooks, or generated persistence mechanisms.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill relies on external web search and fetching competitor pages, which is expected for the purpose but should be limited to public, authorized sources.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background workers, local profile/session access, privilege escalation, destructive commands, or data exfiltration behavior was present.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with the agent researching public competitor websites and review sources. Avoid using it to access private accounts, bypass paywalls, scrape restricted content, or collect personal data beyond what is publicly and lawfully available.
